description: User-visible workflows, status transitions, recovery and support entry points. This is product documentation, not a workflow execution engine.

flows.title: Add a build machine

steps.title: Choose machine and connection
steps.userAction: Choose platform and pairing method, then confirm the SSH fingerprint.
steps.success: Pairing request accepted.
steps.recovery: Recheck hostname, SSH credentials and fingerprint before retrying.

steps.title: Enroll Host Service
steps.success: Host enrollment exists and heartbeat is received.
steps.failure: Host cannot reach controller or enrollment fails.
steps.recovery: Inspect the Host Service and outbound HTTPS connectivity; retry without creating duplicate enrollment.

steps.title: Install GitHub runner
steps.userAction: Watch the builder claim the provisioning action.
steps.success: Host provisioning action completed.
steps.recovery: Review Host Service logs and use Retry GitHub registration after checking action state.

steps.title: Register with GitHub
steps.userAction: Wait for GitHub runner inventory to show this runner.
steps.success: GitHub runner registered in the selected organization.
steps.failure: Registration missing or GitHub authorization expired.
steps.recovery: Verify the organization and reconnect GitHub; do not create duplicate runners.

steps.title: Verify runner online
steps.userAction: Wait for both heartbeat and runner online status.
steps.success: Runner online and host heartbeat fresh.
steps.recovery: Inspect runner service and network connection; use View setup progress.

limitations: The displayed setup stages are not a persisted event log; they are derived from enrollment and GitHub state.
An already enrolled host must not be paired twice.

flows.title: Remove a build machine

steps.title: Confirm machine identity
steps.userAction: Copy the read-only hostname and type the exact value.
steps.success: Exact match enables Continue.
steps.recovery: Use the copy icon in the read-only field; do not substitute a display label.

steps.title: Confirm as administrator
steps.success: Controller accepts the destructive request.
steps.failure: Password rejected or removal preconditions unmet.
steps.recovery: Confirm credentials and check running jobs; never bypass controller authorization.

steps.title: Stop runner
steps.success: Host reports stop completed; unavailable host may require skipped stage.
steps.failure: Runner cannot stop or action expires.
steps.recovery: Check GitHub jobs and host service before choosing Retry or Force remove.

steps.title: Unregister from GitHub
steps.success: Runner registration removed.
steps.recovery: Check organization Actions runners and reconnect GitHub before retrying.

steps.title: Remove software
steps.success: Managed software cleanup acknowledged; unreachable hosts require manual cleanup.
steps.recovery: Use documented host uninstall instructions; preserve unrelated project files.

steps.title: Remove from controller
steps.success: Enrollment removed with audit trail.
steps.recovery: Check removal audit, reconcile or retry; do not claim successful uninstall from an offline host.

limitations: Closing the modal does not cancel removal.
Force removal does not prove local software cleanup.
A persisted phase without a live action is stalled, not active.

flows.title: Upgrade Host Service

steps.title: Check installed version
steps.userAction: Compare installed and available Host Service versions.
steps.success: Version known and upgrade supported.
steps.failure: Version unverified or older than Host Service 0.7.0.
steps.recovery: Migrate the existing host installation over SSH before upgrading to 0.7.0.

steps.title: Queue and stage upgrade
steps.success: Builder verifies and stages version-pinned binary.
steps.recovery: Inspect host logs, artifact digest and controller connection; do not bypass checksum verification.

steps.title: Restart Host Service
steps.success: Host service restarts; rollback attempted on immediate failure.
steps.recovery: Inspect systemd logs and restore backup if necessary.

steps.title: Verify heartbeat
steps.success: Fresh heartbeat reports target version; modal closes.
steps.recovery: Inspect service and controller logs; do not assume an action acknowledgment proves installation.

limitations: Remote upgrades require a compatible installed Host Service.
Rollback only covers immediate restart failures, not every possible runtime regression.

flows.title: Discover attached devices

steps.title: Attach board to builder
steps.userAction: Connect a USB data cable to an enrolled Linux builder.
steps.success: Linux presents a USB serial interface.
steps.failure: Charge-only cable or unsupported USB mode.
steps.recovery: Check lsusb and /dev/serial/by-id on the physical builder.

steps.title: Collect USB descriptors
steps.userAction: Upgrade Host Service to v0.6.0 or later and refresh inventory.
steps.success: Controller receives bounded read-only descriptor report.
steps.failure: Sysfs inaccessible or host lacks discovery.
steps.recovery: Check journalctl for discovery errors, verify Host Service version and builder heartbeat.

steps.title: Review candidate MCU and SDK
steps.userAction: Select SDK options in the device row.
steps.success: Catalog shows candidate families, SDK and evidence status.
steps.failure: USB ID unknown or only an adapter is identified.
steps.recovery: Treat as unknown; proceed to controlled read-only chip identification when available.

limitations: USB VID/PID cannot establish exact MCU or board identity.
Current Go scanner covers Linux USB serial interfaces only.

flows.title: Verify microcontroller chip

steps.title: Select connected target
steps.userAction: Choose an enrolled builder and connected USB device.
steps.success: Fresh identity and port validated.
steps.recovery: Reconnect device and rescan.

steps.title: Run read-only chip probe
steps.success: Supported tool reports chip family and revision.
steps.recovery: Inspect connection and supported adapters; never guess from USB IDs.

limitations: Read-only chip probing is not implemented.
Chip verification is required before flash eligibility.

steps.title: Select verified artifact
steps.success: Checksum, source commit, SDK and board target verified.
steps.recovery: Build a compatible firmware artifact first.

steps.title: Verify connected device
steps.userAction: Confirm exact chip and physical port.
steps.success: Fresh chip identity and port lock confirmed.
steps.failure: Chip mismatch, device moved or port busy.
steps.recovery: Reidentify device. Do not override safety gates.

steps.title: Authorize flash
steps.success: Audited operation approved.
steps.recovery: Review selection and request approval again.

steps.title: Flash and verify
steps.success: Adapter verifies written firmware and records deployment.
steps.recovery: Use adapter-specific recovery and bootloader instructions; never assume device is safe to retry blindly.
